hero.sub: No code, no crypto skills. A phone or a browser is enough: create a wallet in 30 seconds.
hero.pitchLine: A blockchain for ordinary people: your own token, club NFT cards and raising money for an idea — no code.
hero.trustLine: Verified people only · one person, one address · Built on Base

stages.label: Wallet in 30 seconds
stages.sub: Keys stay on your phone or browser.

stages.label: Your token goes live
stages.sub: Name and ticker — the curve sets the price.

hero.saleNote: PEOPLE Mainnet Beta opens 1 December 2026: pay in USDC or USDT on Base; PPL are credited on PEOPLE Mainnet Beta.

community.title: 10% of every new token goes to your people — guaranteed
community.lead: At launch the creator can also send the unsold curve remainder (up to ~17%) to the pool instead of burning it — up to 27% in total.
community.statLabel: of every new token's supply goes to its community pool
community.statNote: The pool is governed by the PEOPLE timelock and paid out to verified people over time, not instantly; this is not a yield promise.
community.footnote: Network fees are split separately: {{community}}% to the community pool, {{validators}}% to validators.

build.title: What you can do without code
build.lead: Everything below runs in your browser. Nothing to install, nothing to compile.

cards.title: Launch a club or community token in a minute
cards.body: Pick a name, a ticker, an image and a supply. Pay the launch fee in PEOPLE and the token is live on its own bonding curve.

cards.title: Mint NFT club cards
cards.body: Membership cards as NFTs: one per member, with an image you upload or generate in the browser.

cards.title: Raise funding for your idea
cards.body: Your community buys in on the curve from the first trade, so the price is set by real demand instead of a private round.

cards.title: Describe a smart contract in plain words
cards.body: Write what you want in ordinary language and get a contract built from audited OpenZeppelin templates. You see the result before you deploy.

fair.title: The same rules for every community
fair.lead: Three rules are built into the protocol, not promised in a post.

tiles.title: of every new token goes to that token's community pool (10% guaranteed)
tiles.body: Not to the network, not to the creator. Up to 27% in total if the creator sends curve leftovers to the pool at launch.

tiles.title: before a creator's share is fully unlocked
tiles.body: The creator's allocation vests linearly over 180 days, so there is no dump on day one.

tiles.title: of network fees are burned — people get them instead
tiles.body: Every fee is split between validators, the community pool, the treasury, liquidity and Growth. Nothing is destroyed to fake scarcity.

foundersTeaser.title: Founding 1,000 seats are open
foundersTeaser.lead: Claim a Founding Seat now. Roster and order stay sealed until 1,000 verified wallets lock in.
foundersTeaser.cardHint: Two levels, active people only, 10% up front and the rest over 52 weeks.

agents.title: Agents that work for the group
agents.lead: Agents are first-class users of the network: they pay for what they use and answer to the people they serve.
